notes.title: Major Optimizations Coming
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone and thanks for helping out with the Early Access release!  

After receiving some very specific and useful feedback from several players I have been looking into optimizations. I have made some major improvements in that space already and plan to have a large update pushed out by next Saturday morning. 

There will also be some additional material at the beginning of the game to help those that do not have command line experience.

I have also received some feedback on the types of game activities that should be expanded upon and those that should be avoided - This is the reason I went early access for this so please keep the input flowing!
